title: Use the powerful cloud brain to coordinate parallel specialist models
goal: Make the strongest eligible working cloud brain plan, assign, monitor and synthesize parallel work across other working model-backed agents. Specialists may use models suited to their job; the primary brain retains evidence-backed coordination without forcing all jobs through one provider quota. Preserve separate claims/worktrees, shared budgets, verified results and independent reviewer provenance. Coordination must not serialize independent jobs unnecessarily or become an unbounded single point of failure; checkpoint and replace an unavailable brain safely. Hermetic integration tests demonstrate overlapping roadmap work, real coordinator inference and successful continuation after coordinator failure. Implement nonzero tests named powerful_cloud_brain_parallel_* exercising production behavior.
